name: Microwave Mushroom Barley
ingredients: 1 small onion and 2 garlic cloves, chopped
¾ cup hot vegetable stock, 1 tbsp soy sauce
steps: In a large bowl, microwave the oil, onion and garlic covered for 2 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and thyme, cover and microwave for 4 minutes until they release liquid.
Stir in the barley, tofu, stock and soy sauce.
Cover and microwave for 4 minutes, stir, and stand for 2 minutes.
note: Make a batch of barley ahead (it keeps 4 days in the fridge) so this takes minutes.
